headline: S. 1881 would have barred federal money from going to Planned Parenthood Federation of America and its affiliates, but the Senate did not pass it.
what_it_does: The bill would have prohibited federal funding for Planned Parenthood Federation of America. It would also have covered its affiliates, subsidiaries, successors, and clinics. The Senate refused to take up the bill or end debate on it on August 3, 2015, so it was not adopted.

who_it_affects.group: Planned Parenthood Federation of America and its affiliates, subsidiaries, successors, and clinics
who_it_affects.how: They would have been barred from receiving federal funding under the bill.

who_it_affects.group: Patients who receive health services at Planned Parenthood clinics
who_it_affects.how: Clinics that lost federal funding could have changed which services they offer or how many locations stay open, according to the bill's general reach.
